## The first Kinema

A native iPhone and iPad client for **Jellyfin**, with the look of **Kultr** and a player made for watching.

- **Home**: a carousel of what's new, **Continue Watching**, **Next Up**, the newest in each library, favourites, collections and genres, in the order you choose.
- **Title pages** tinted by their own artwork: the backdrop across the top, the title's logo, badges for 4K, HDR, Dolby Vision, Atmos and 5.1, Play or Resume, watched, favourite, download and trailer, seasons and episodes, cast & crew, extras, similar titles, versions and the file's tracks.
- **Libraries** with sorting, filters (unwatched, in progress, favourites, genres, years), an A–Z jump and a quick filter; **Search** across films, shows, episodes, people and collections.
- **The player**: double-tap to skip, hold for 2× (swipe up to keep it), swipe for brightness, volume and seeking with trickplay thumbnails, pinch to fill, 0.25× to 4×, chapters, **Skip Intro**, **Skip Credits**, **Up Next**, an episode list, screen lock, Picture in Picture, AirPlay, playback info and screenshots.
- **Subtitles your way**: size, colour, outline, background, brightness, font and position, two tracks at once, timing adjustment, and online subtitle search through your server.
- **Plays everything your server has**: MP4 and MOV directly; MKV, DTS, TrueHD and the rest repackaged or converted by the server as you watch. HEVC, HDR10, HLG and Dolby Vision where the iPhone supports them.
- **Downloads** to watch offline, as the original or a smaller copy, with subtitles; progress goes back to the server when you're online again.
- **Several servers and users**, password or **Quick Connect** sign-in, and Jellyfin's demo to try it without a server.
- **Liquid glass** on iOS 26 and a floating glass tab bar on iOS 17 and 18; dark, light and Night mode.

## Install

Download **Kinema.ipa** below and install it with **Sideloadly** (Windows, Mac), **AltStore** (Windows, Mac) or **Impactor** (Linux) — or with no computer at all, through **SideStore** installed by **SideInstaller** (only from sideinstaller.net) with **LocalDevVPN** connected. New to this? Follow the step-by-step guide: https://github.com/evropiani/Kinema/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md

Kinema needs iOS 17 or later and a Jellyfin server (10.9 or later; 10.10 or later for Skip Intro and Skip Credits).
